final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT ma.player_id, p.bats, COUNT(*) AS records FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.bats), step2 AS (SELECT bats, COUNT(player_id) AS player_count FROM step1 GROUP BY bats), step3 AS (SELECT SUM(player_count) AS total_count FROM step2) SELECT step2.bats, step2.player_count, 1.0 * step2.player_count / step3.total_count FROM step2 JOIN step3 ON step3.total_count IS NOT NULL
